## Original generation prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SIX-pose full-body sprite sheet for a miniature chess victory animation. Truly transparent RGBA background. Arrange exactly six separate complete figures in a regular THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid, evenly spaced, each safely contained within its own cell with generous clear margins. No grid, labels, floor or background. SAME elegant ice wizard character in every pose: elderly silver-bearded male mage in layered deep midnight-blue robes with icy cyan embroidery, silver shoulder details, pale blue hood, leather boots, holding a long silver staff topped by a large solid faceted cyan ice crystal. Refined realistic painted fantasy game miniature with crisp coherent anatomy, detailed fabrics, natural highlights, readable at 130px tall. Camera is fixed, three-quarter side profile facing RIGHT. Exactly two arms, two hands, two legs, one head, one staff; staff always held in a hand, fully intact and visibly connected to the figure. Identical face, clothing, scale, character body position and common foot baseline throughout the six cells. Top row left to right: (1) calm standing pose staff upright, (2) forward step with a slightly billowing robe and upright staff, (3) winding up a spell by lifting the staff overhead, feet planted. Bottom row left to right: (4) thrusting the staff diagonally to the RIGHT, cyan crystal pointing toward an opponent at chest height, (5) holding that rightward casting pose, robe swaying slightly, (6) relaxed proud victory pose with lowered shoulders and staff upright at the side. Full body, staff and crystal entirely inside each cell. No actual spell beam, loose snowflakes, floating crystals, smoke, magic ring, chess pieces, shadows, words or watermark; effects are added in the app. Preserve real transparency. Prefer landscape 1536x1024.

## Background cleanup prompt

Edit this sprite sheet only: remove the entire dark blue/gray photographic background, every cloudy glow and every floor shadow, making all the space between and around the SIX wizards genuinely fully transparent (alpha zero). Keep all six complete wizard figures, their silver staffs and cyan crystal tips EXACTLY as they are, preserving poses, face, colors, intricate robe details, spatial arrangement and original canvas dimensions. Do not redraw or move any figure. The hard opaque silhouettes of robes, hair, hands, boots, staff and solid ice crystals must remain intact with clean natural anti-aliased edges. No haze or ambient glow around figures. No added shadow, smoke, scenery, text, frames, checkerboard pattern or colored background. The output is an RGBA sprite sheet cutout for use on a light chess-app UI.
